name: DFTB+
description: Builds DFTB+ 26.1 (density functional tight binding; program dftb+, its tools and libdftbplus) into /usr/local with GCC, OpenMP threads and OpenBLAS from the release source archive, with xTB through tblite, s-dftd3, electron transport and socket communication, and without many-body dispersion. It is the threaded build that DFTB+ documents as its default; Slater-Koster files are not included, and the ASE calculator finds them through DFTB_PREFIX.
